scope: Versioned union of supported vendor-listed assets, recent pools, and decoded successful creation events.
steps: Freeze supported networks, protocols, time interval, classification, and provider permissions.
Collect every accessible page/cursor; preserve raw hashes, timestamps, errors, and provider caps.
Keep asset identities separate from pool, venue, wrapped, and derivative identities.
Reconcile identities and units against current chain state; unresolved records remain quarantined.
Decode economic events and retain later failures, deletions, and non-graduating launches.
Emit partial or unknown coverage when provider or archive limits prevent completeness.
Apply the separate screening policy before any experiment eligibility.
refresh_policy: Continuous or scheduled collection must be designed against actual provider limits; none is running in this pack.
